transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We've got four steel coils — C1, C2, C3, and C4 — on hold at the receiving dock because the labels don't match the mill-certificate packet. Each coil is 300 kilograms, and they're intended for two active production jobs. Before I can make the binding disposition and release any material, I need to go through the routine: identity check, documented job assignment, and receiving disposition. So let's get started. Quality assurance — what's your status on these coils?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Quality assurance status: My receiving inspection found that the certificate mismatch requires 100% positive-material-identification testing on all four coils before any of them can be released. I completed the inspection this morning, but the inspection worksheet is still waiting to be attached to the receiving record.

transcript.text: Production control status: My current production schedule assigns exactly 600 kilograms of grade 304 to Job Alpha for Thursday and exactly 600 kilograms of grade 316 to Job Beta for Monday.
